skills.description:
This skill generates an interactive HTML dashboard of tennis tournament entry
lists (Main Draw 正赛 and Qualifying 资格赛: entries, alternates, withdrawals)
from spaziotennis.com entry-list articles. It supports multiple concurrent
events at once, with a 备注 column marking when a player is OUT/withdrawn in
one event but IN or in the draw in another (i.e. "选择了 B 赛事"), and a live
promotion rule where withdrawing an entry promotes the top alternate. It also
optionally cross-checks supplied events against the official ATP Tour calendar
(atptour.com/en/tournaments) to flag any same-period ATP Tour event the user
may have missed. When the user provides only tournament names (e.g. "ATP 北京",
"ATP 东京") instead of a URL, the agent auto-discovers the spaziotennis
entry-list page via web search, handling the site's Italian city exonyms
(Pechino=Beijing, Tokio=Tokyo) and the entry-list URL pattern.
